verdict.rationale: CoreWeave's own docs describe Spot Node Pools as pay-as-you-go bare-metal capacity without commitments. Capacity Finder checks Spot placement availability across Zones, and the pricing page mentions Spot capacity with "great pricing." The pack shows no discount levels and no preemption or interruption rules, so only the core spot offering is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented preemption/interruption semantics (notice period, eviction behavior), quantified discount versus on-demand, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can rent spot or interruptible GPU capacity at a deep discount with clearly documented preemption semantics

citations.quote: Spot Node Pools provide pay-as-you-go access to high-performance bare-metal compute resources without long-term commitments or reservations.
Quickly spin-up burst On-Demand or Spot capacity—with the flexibility of great pricing.
use Capacity Finder in the Cloud Console to compare placement availability across Zones for one or more GPU and CPU instance types
